title: Feasibility: does tracked Combine peak speed add information beyond the official 40 for WR game speed?
status: Committed BEFORE any simulation result was generated. Simulation only; no real Combine x game-outcome model is fitted.
population: registered H1-WR eligible set (57 WR, run 20261121T135032Z); design = per player x context x team-season play counts only
outcome: player's true context-adjusted mean play-maximum speed, composite = equal-weight mean of the deep and short player effects (H1 contexts and covariates unchanged)

calibration_outcome_only.source: Phase 4 outcome-only REML calibration (synthetic_validation.md section 1); no predictor involved

calibration_combine_only.note: R_F (official 40) is not identified; admissible lower bound r^2 / mean(R_P) = 0.777

not_used: any observed H1 or Phase 2 predictor-outcome association; effect sizes are a grid

grid.R_F_note: 0.78 = single-construct world (true peak = true 40 speed, rho* ~ 1): only pi = 0 is defined

estimands.E1_incremental_association: observed-scale coefficient of standardised tracked peak given standardised official 40 (WLS two-stage, HC3; frozen confirmatory.wls_two_stage)
estimands.E2_incremental_prediction: Delta R^2_CV (M3 - M1) on held-out PLAYERS' shrunken composite levels
estimands.E3_measurement_precision: observed-scale E1 that arises when true peak = true 40 speed (single-construct world)
estimands.E4_distinct_construct: true partial pi of true peak given true 40; requires R_F (EIV, frozen confirmatory.eiv_two_stage)

criteria.C1_validity: rejection rate of E1 at pi = 0, R_F = 0.99 <= 0.075 for every a, and HC3 95% CI coverage of the population observed-scale coefficient >= 0.92 in every cell
criteria.C2_power_central: power of E1 (two-sided alpha 0.05) at pi = 0.3, R_F = 0.90, a = 0.5
criteria.C3_power_robust: minimum power of E1 at pi = 0.3 over R_F in {0.85, 0.90, 0.95, 0.99} and a in {0.3, 0.5, 0.7}
criteria.C4_construct_identifiability: rejection rate of E1 at pi = 0 for R_F in {0.78, 0.85} <= 0.10 (otherwise a significant E1 cannot be read as a distinct construct)
criteria.C5_prediction: at pi = 0.3, R_F = 0.90, a = 0.5: mean Delta R^2_CV >= 0.02 and P(Delta R^2_CV > 0) >= 0.80
criteria.GO: C1 passes AND C2 >= 0.80 AND C3 >= 0.70 AND C4 passes AND C5 passes
criteria.CONDITIONAL_GO: C1 passes AND C2 >= 0.50 (exploratory estimation of E1/E2 only; E4 reported as non-identified if C4 fails)
